# `sd_card_device_kicad10.kicad_mod`

`Connector_Card.pretty/SD_Card_Device_16mm_SlotDepth.kicad_mod`, copied
unmodified from KiCad 10.0.6's stock footprint library
(`/usr/share/kicad/footprints`, Fedora 44 `kicad-10.0.6-1.fc44`, generator
version `20260206`).

It was picked as the smallest stock footprint that has `default`, `solid` and
`dash` strokes as well as visible `(unlocked yes)` text. `pcb_components`'
tests read its graphics for #970.

| Element | `(type …)` | Count |
|---------|------------|-------|
| `fp_line` | `default` | 14 |
| `fp_arc` | `default` | 5 |
| `fp_rect` | `default` | 1 |
| `fp_poly` | `solid` | 1 |
| `fp_line` | `dash` | 1 |

Its three `fp_text user` items (`PCB Thickness 1.4mm`, `Write Protect Notch`,
`${REFERENCE}`) are all `(unlocked yes)`. The counts come from the file, not
from Konnect's parser.
